race.comment: CHISPA (2) has raced in stronger company this prep and the blinkers go on today. Struggled to close off with the 58.5kg when sixth over 2000m at Flemington in BM80 class last time out. J Mac sticks and no excuses today on a course she's proven at. DONATELLO (5) frustrating gelding desperate for this trip and shapes as the main danger to his stablemate. Gave away too much start again when he warmed up late to finish second over 1800m at Rosehill. Winning rider hops back aboard and can measure up.  WITHOUT PEER (3) much better effort when he jumped in trip to figure in the minor money over 1800m at Rosehill. Yet to be tested at the trip and place preferred. NKOSI (6) comes back in distance and gets in light with Roper's claim.
